newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gabelli sees LIN TV in 50s.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gabelli sees LIN TV in 50s.

text.p: -- Gabelli & Co Inc said LIN Television Corp shares could be valued in the mid-50s.
-- projects private market value (PMV) price of 53 for 1997 and 57 for 1998.
-- said that if AT&T, which currently owns 45 percent of LIN Television, still owns 25 percent or more of the company in January 1998, a PMV guarantee process is triggered.
-- said at that time, AT&T must either acquire the remaining shares of LIN TV at private market value or put LIN TV up for sale.
-- said most likely that AT&T will liquidate its LIN TV shares prior to January 1998 and that the shares would fetch their PMV in a timely fashion.
-- A Gabelli spokesman said that buy side affiliate Gabelli Funds Inc owns less than five percent of LIN TV shares outstanding.
-- LIN TV stock traded down 1-1/2 to 38-1/2 in the afternoon.
